title: N -W F P Civil Courts Amendment Act 1994

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Civil Courts Amendment Act 1994
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 1994
ACT IV OF 1994
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE CIVIL COURTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act further to amend the West
Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 26th October, 1994]
No.PA/N.-W.F.P./Legis/94/19/19180,
dated 26-10-1994: --The North-West Frontier Province Civil Courts (Amendment)
Bill, 1994, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West
Frontier Province on the 17th October, 1994 and assented to by the Governor of
the North-West Frontier Province on the 25th October, 1994, is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and commencement: -(1) This Act may be called the
North-West Frontier Province Civil Courts (Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 19th August, 1994.

Frontier Province on the 17th October, 1994 and assented to by the Governor of
the North-West Frontier Province on the 25th October, 1994, is hereby published

2. Amendment of section 18 of W.P. Ord. II of 1962.-- In the West
Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance; 1962 (W.P. Ord. 11 of 1962), in section 18, in
clause (a) of subsection (1), for the words "fifty thousand" the
words "five hundred" shall be substituted.
